paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
coupling_convention: canonical g_aNN in GeV^-1, as plotted
notes: NASDUCK-SERF comagnetometer (3He + 39K SERF) constrains both ALP-neutron (g_aNN) and ALP-proton (g_aPP) couplings, both in GeV^-1, over mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. The paper is one of the first terrestrial ALP-proton bounds. Reported g_aNN neutron bound extracted here (AxionNeutron per hint). Precise tabulated bounds available at github.com/ItayBM/NASDUCKSERF; the y-axis values here are approximate reads off Fig. 2 (mean/best exclusion line). The proton bound g_aPP reaches ~5e-6 to 2e-5 GeV^-1 in similar mass range.
